trans-unit.source: You've already surpassed your father at swordsmanship, haven't you?
trans-unit.target: You've already surpassed your father at swordsmanship, haven't you?

trans-unit.source: I'm not sure I'm there yet.
trans-unit.target: I'm not sure I'm there yet.

trans-unit.source: Once you do, we'll have a bona fide case of “the student becoming the master.”
trans-unit.target: Once you do, we'll have a bona fide case of “the student becoming the master.”

trans-unit.source: Just an old saying when the pupil or son surpasses his master or father.
trans-unit.target: Just an old saying when the pupil or son surpasses his master or father.

trans-unit.source: So I guess it's kinda like a half-elf being stronger than a full-blooded one?
trans-unit.target: So I guess it's kinda like a half-elf being stronger than a full-blooded one?

trans-unit.source: Hmmmm, well... In SOME ways, I suppose.
